items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I was also with two other American musicians, Paolo Alderighi and Stephanie Trick. We were doing some gigs together at the beginning of March.

ctx.x: You anticipated a question I was going to ask and that is most musicians were sitting waiting for the phone to ring and the more it rang, the more we knew what was coming. Like okay this is cancelled, now who’s next? But I was going to ask if you had to initiate cancellations and indeed you have quite a —

Yes because as you know, family comes first. So not only I couldn’t get back to Australia — because I’d been on the road and that’s the worst situation for a virus like this. So I knew I couldn’t go back to Australia right away, then I wouldn’t know how I would come back to Connecticut to be with my husband and stepson. So I had my parents on FaceTiming and said, “You’ve got to get out of Europe, you’ve got to get out now. And I said well I have to go home, I mean I have to come here. And fortunately I was able…

November now. I just talked to a European promoter this morning and they said, “Oh we might have you over for two weeks in September.” I said, “Well it has to be worth the airfare and I have to know it’s — I can get there and come home, back here, you know what I mean? So there’s a lot more questions raised now about touring. I mean I used to get on a plane every other week like it was nothing you know. Now I have to think about my family. Now I have to think about travel routing and are there going to be flights…
